notes: These are unexecuted, data-only test specifications, except the historical CP077 unsafe witness which was previously reproduced.
Do not infer security admission from data-only schedules or 60/60 CP077 expected test outcomes.
No live GitHub credentials, provider, model-authored source or production effect authorized.

cases.description: CP077 baseline: revoke after final etcd read before local Git CAS
cases.security_assertion: Baseline NEGATIVE witness; 60/60 expected outcomes included real security failure; NOT an acceptance PASS.

cases.description: Issuer processes revoke before durable prepare
cases.security_assertion: Issuer must block prepare and admission.

cases.description: Issuer processes revoke after intent prepared
cases.security_assertion: No extra etcd read may substitute for same-authority transaction.

cases.description: Concurrent revoke/admission serializes revoke first
cases.security_assertion: Provider transaction order is explicit.

cases.description: Concurrent revoke/admission serializes admission first
cases.security_assertion: Option A: effect after request allowed; no effective revoke ACK until terminal.

cases.description: Revoke after last non-atomic read but before the new provider admission transaction
cases.security_assertion: Permanent fixed version of CP077 unsafe postcheck barrier.

cases.description: Revoke request after irrevocable admission but before dispatch
cases.security_assertion: Requires clear operator revocation semantics; no premature effective ACK.

cases.description: Revoke after network send but before response
cases.security_assertion: No retry; effect may land after request; no REVOKED_EFFECTIVE ACK.

cases.description: Revoke while independent verifier has not confirmed effect
cases.security_assertion: Ack effective only after exact remote readback and authorship evidence.

cases.description: Revocation after terminal reconciliation
cases.security_assertion: No post-effective new effects.

cases.description: Real provider TTL expiry before commit transaction
cases.security_assertion: Provider must not issue grant on expired lease.

cases.description: Natural TTL expiry after immutable admission
cases.security_assertion: TTL does not revoke already admitted irreversible permission under Option A.

cases.description: Local wall clock moved backward after revoke
cases.security_assertion: Epoch/provider revision dominates local time.

cases.description: Valid signature with kernel OS peer UID mismatch
cases.security_assertion: Kernel peer verified by sink.

cases.description: Wrong Ed25519 signer public key fingerprints
cases.security_assertion: Exact issuer-approved key pin.

cases.description: Signed stale generation submitted after successor
cases.security_assertion: Stale owner/generation rejected in provider txn.

cases.description: Signed claim issued to a different physical host
cases.security_assertion: Physical host binding enforced, not online status.

cases.description: Different task attempted with otherwise valid scope
cases.security_assertion: Task identity immutable.

cases.description: Leased GPU differs from proposed executor GPU
cases.security_assertion: No parallel GPU collision.

cases.description: Ref switched from task branch to protected main
cases.security_assertion: Full ref fixed in grant.

cases.description: Worker replaces expected oldOID with current remote tip
cases.security_assertion: Never refresh an immutable expected-old ref.

cases.description: Byte-changed generated source after signing
cases.security_assertion: Pinned exact source and Git tree verified.

cases.description: Second sink process uses another OS identity
cases.security_assertion: Only credential owner and authorized SO_PEERCRED actor.

cases.description: Valid previously consumed nonce replayed
cases.security_assertion: Provider intent version prevents duplicate.

cases.description: Two authorized host/GPU claims try same repo/ref
cases.security_assertion: Repo/ref exclusion independent of GPU exclusivity.

cases.description: Two task refs share same physical GPU
cases.security_assertion: Resource exclusion independent of repo/ref separation.

cases.description: Issuer restarts after PREPARED before admission
cases.security_assertion: No unlogged grant from stale WAL.

cases.description: Issuer restarts after durable admitted revision
cases.security_assertion: Admission survives restart; no successor while unknown.

cases.description: Sink dies after grant, before durable send-start marker
cases.security_assertion: No absence-of-effect inference from missing ACK alone.

cases.description: Sink dies just after durable network send marker
cases.security_assertion: Durable unknown, no blind retry.

cases.description: GitHub accepts exact ref update but caller times out
cases.security_assertion: Remote ref readback plus intent provenance required.

cases.description: Another owner advanced tip so beforeOid fails
cases.security_assertion: Fast-forward success is not oldOID CAS.

cases.description: Ref moves old -> thirdParty -> old before update
cases.security_assertion: oldOID alone does not prove lack of intervening effects.

cases.description: A different writer sets exact same afterOID
cases.security_assertion: Readback alone does not prove sink authored the effect.

cases.description: Remote API yields 5xx after request was transmitted
cases.security_assertion: No retry or false no-effect.

cases.description: No approved GraphQL expected-old ref update capability
cases.security_assertion: Never degrade to REST force:false as exact oldOID CAS.

cases.description: Verifier's audit digest differs from intended commit/tree
cases.security_assertion: Receipt is not a success if source/tree differ.

cases.description: Independent reconciler cannot distinguish no write from overwritten write
cases.security_assertion: Old remote ref alone cannot exclude ABA/rollbacks.

cases.description: Owner attempts to release host/GPU/ref during UNKNOWN
cases.security_assertion: Never show effective revoke or grant overlapping resource while unresolved.

cases.description: Closed generation submits newly signed but stale request
cases.security_assertion: No effect after effective revoke.

cases.description: PR code attempts to mark its own trusted check PASS
cases.security_assertion: Separate policy runner and privileged status publisher required.

cases.description: GitHub Actions/webhook executes well after verified ref mutation
cases.security_assertion: Must not imply ref-only revocation prevents downstream effects.
